title: Titles of the Virgin and the unbroken seal
english: Every right-minded tongue rightly greets the virgin and Mother of God, and each imitates Gabriel, the chief of the angels, as far as it can. One says to her, “Rejoice,” while another proclaims, “The Lord is from you,” because of the Lord who was born from her and appeared with flesh to the human race. One names her Mother of light, another Star of life, another calls her Throne of God, another Temple greater than heaven, another Seat not less than the seat of the cherubim, another again an unsown garden, fruitful and untilled, a Vine with fine clusters, flourishing and untouched, a pure Dove, an undefiled Pigeon, a Cloud that receives the rain without corruption, a Pouch whose pearl is brighter than the sun, a Mine from which the stone covering the whole earth comes forth with no one quarrying it, a merchant vessel laden with cargo and needing no helmsman, a Treasure that creates wealth. Others likewise call her a Lampstand without fuel that kindles itself, an Ark wider than Noah’s, taller and more glorious. That ark held living creatures, but this one holds life; that one held mortal creatures, but this one holds immortal life; that one carried Noah, but this one carried the Maker of Noah. That one had two and three stories, but this one held the whole fullness of the Trinity, since the Spirit was present, the Father overshadowed, and the Son dwelt in a tent while being carried in the womb. For it says, “The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you; therefore the child to be born will be called holy, the Son of God” (Luke 1:35). Do you see how great and how vast is the dignity of the virgin Mother of God? For the only-begotten Son of God, the Maker of the world, was carried by her as an infant, and he refashioned Adam, sanctified Eve, destroyed the dragon, opened paradise, and secured the seal of her womb. Both of these were entirely fitting and reasonable: he opened paradise because he was about to bring in the thief and lead by the hand all the heirs of the kingdom into it. He was securing the seal of her womb because, being God and Word, the one being made flesh had absolutely no need of doors for his entrance or his exit.

So then, virgin, the prophets divide your praises among themselves, and each of the God-bearing ones speaks the mysteries of wonders entrusted to him. One calls you the Rod of Jesse, to hint at the invulnerable and unbending character of your virginity. Another compares you to the Bush that burned and was not consumed, to hint at the flesh of the only-begotten and at the virgin Mother of God. For the bush burned and was not consumed, because she gave birth and did not open her womb; she conceived and did not corrupt her womb; she brought forth the infant and left her belly sealed; she supplied...

orientation: Hesychius, a priest of Jerusalem, opens his homily by praising Mary with a chain of biblical and natural titles, then explains how the only-begotten Son was carried by her as an infant while opening paradise and keeping the seal of her womb unbroken.
